name: Imbalance
source:
Main character participates in occult school club. When rumors start to spread about strange events at night, he volunteers to investigate them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角參加了學校的神秘學社團。夜裡發生怪事的傳聞開始流傳後，他自告奮勇，前去調查。

（摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]）
